storyline.real: Alonso wins his home race from 5th on the grid on four stops; Räikkönen, on three, finishes second, 9.3 s behind. Massa is third.
storyline.headline: Räikkönen's three stops beat Alonso's four in Barcelona

mastery.label: Win on two more stops, as Räikkönen made

eras.briefing: Barcelona, 2013. The tyres wear fast. Alonso started fifth, has already stopped once and leads. You run Räikkönen, fourth, on a plan with one stop fewer than Alonso's. Make it work and win.
